summary: Add actorless offline fractal work validate-request FILE|- to validate a native person request and print its canonical JSON value.

replay.detail: Uses the existing StructuredRequest::parse; no replay changes.

schema.detail: No new request schema, serializer, digest, claims or tables.

rules.detail: No work ask or admission changes. Recognition, including malformed arguments, exits before instance, completion, actor, runtime, configuration or client initialization and does not write ST_GATE_REPORT.

compatibility.detail: The new source command accepts only a file or stdin (-), without actor or global flags. Success prints one canonical JSON value; errors use stderr and a nonzero exit. Canonical bytes or digests are not promised; server image/attachment enrichment and client_view are outside final-stored equality.

downtime.detail: No deployment or runtime adoption is authorized by this source change.

manual.detail: Installed wrapper admission, publication and adoption require separate approval; no wrapper exemption is added.

recovery.detail: The offline command does not mutate persistent state.
